basics.name: adminPassword
basics.toolTip: Password for the CloudGrange administrator account. Must be at least 12 characters and contain uppercase, lowercase, digit, and special character.

constraints.validationMessage: Password must be at least 12 characters and contain uppercase, lowercase, a digit, and a special character.

elements.name: environmentName
elements.label: Environment
elements.toolTip: The environment tier. Used as a prefix for Azure resource names (e.g. rg-cloudgrange-dev-eus-001).

elements.name: imageTag
elements.label: Container Image Tag
elements.toolTip: The CloudGrange container image version to deploy. Use 'v1.0.0' for the latest stable release. Do not use 'latest' in production.

constraints.validationMessage: Must be a valid container tag (e.g. v1.0.0, main, or a SHA digest).

elements.name: postgresAdminUser
elements.label: Database Administrator Username
elements.toolTip: Username for the PostgreSQL administrator account.

constraints.validationMessage: Must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, or underscores (2–63 characters).

elements.name: costCenter
elements.label: Cost Center
elements.toolTip: Cost center tag applied to all deployed resources. Used for billing allocation.

elements.name: ownerEmail
elements.label: Owner Email
elements.toolTip: Email address of the team or individual responsible for this deployment. Used for budget and alert notifications.
